 #SHOWBIZ: K-pop stars NCT 127 bring 10th-anniversary tour to KL in January 
 By Nst Entertainment 
 November 14, 2026 @ 5:36pm 
 Global K-pop powerhouse NCT 127 will stage their first full-scale arena concert in Malaysia at the Unifi Arena on Jan 9, 2027. Pic courtesy of starplanet
 KUALA LUMPUR: Global K-pop powerhouse NCT 127 will stage their first full-scale arena concert in Malaysia early next year.
 The group is bringing their 10th-anniversary tour, NCT 127 5TH TOUR 'NEO CITY : KUALA LUMPUR – THE REDLINE', to the Unifi Arena on Jan 9, 2027.
 Following the release of their seventh studio album, BLINGY, the tour celebrates a decade of music and live performance.
 It kicked off in September with an explosive three-night run at Seoul's KSPO DOME, drawing over 30,000 fans alongside global cinema screenings.
 Kuala Lumpur now joins a major Asian itinerary that includes stops in Singapore, Bangkok, Jakarta, and Hong Kong.
 Formed in July 2016, NCT 127 has built an enduring legacy with hit anthems ranging from "Cherry Bomb" and "Kick It" to "2 Baddies" and "Fact Check".
 Known for their sharp choreography, powerful vocals, and high-energy stage production, the group has earned major industry honours, including Album of the Year (2021) and Stage of the Year (2024) at the Asia Artist Awards.
 Registered "NCTzen 127" Membership (GL) holders can access priority tickets on Nov 19 from 12pm to 5pm. Fans must register via Weverse between Nov 13 (12pm) and Nov 15 (11.59pm) to qualify.
 Public tickets go on sale on Nov 20 at 12pm via https://my.bookmyshow.com/en .
 For further updates, visit www.starplanet.com.my .
